_snapshotData.name: Oracle Corporation
_snapshotData.description: Oracle Corporation offers products and services that build, run and support enterprise information technology frameworks worldwide. Its Oracle cloud software as a service offering includes various cloud software applications, including Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise resource planning ERP, Oracle Fusion cloud enterprise performance management EPM, Oracle Fusion cloud supply chain and manufacturing management SCM, Oracle Fusion cloud human capital management HCM, and NetSuite applications suite, Oracle Health applications, as well as Oracle Fusion Sales, Service, and Marketing. The company also offers cloud-based industry solutions for various industries; Oracle cloud license and on-premise license; and Oracle license support services. In addition, it provides cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies, such as the Oracle Database and MySQL Database; Java, a software development language; and middleware, including development tools and others. The company's cloud and license business' infrastructure technologies also comprise cloud-based compute, storage, and networking capabilities; and Oracle autonomous database, as well as AI, Internet-of-Things, machine learning, digital assistant, and blockchain. Further, it provides hardware products and other hardware-related software offerings, including Oracle engineered systems, enterprise servers, storage solutions, industry-specific hardware, virtualization software, operating systems, management software, and related hardware support services, and consulting and advanced customer services. It markets and sells its cloud, license, hardware, support, and services offerings directly to businesses in various industries, government agencies, and educational institutions, as well as through indirect channels. Oracle Corporation has a strategic alliance with Metron, Inc. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Austin, Texas.

moatAnalysis.moat_narrative: Oracle Corporation possesses a narrow economic moat (score: 59/100). Strongest advantages: Supply-Side Economies (strong) and Switching Costs (moderate). Oracle Corporation has strong supply-side economies of scale.

supply_side.explanation: Oracle Corporation has strong supply-side economies of scale. Revenue growing at 29.6% with earnings growing at 54.5% — positive 24.9% operating leverage. strong gross margins of 64.0% and operating margins of 35.6% at at significant scale.

network_effects.explanation: Oracle Corporation has limited demand-side economies of scale. Software - Infrastructure suggests limited network potential. Financial trends do not strongly indicate network effects. Awaiting user product-level assessment.

learning_curve.explanation: Oracle Corporation has weak learning curve advantages. Software - Infrastructure has limited knowledge barriers. Historical margin data confirms sustained high margins.

switching_costs.explanation: Oracle Corporation benefits from moderate switching costs. Software - Infrastructure offers relatively easy substitution. 64% gross margins suggest customers pay premium rather than switch. YoY revenue growth of 29.6% indicates strong customer retention.

aiDisruption.threat_analysis: Software - Infrastructure has limited AI disruption risk. Physical infrastructure, regulatory moats, and tangible assets provide insulation.
aiDisruption.opportunity_analysis: AI offers limited transformative potential for Software - Infrastructure. Benefits are primarily operational efficiency gains.
aiDisruption.net_assessment: Oracle Corporation faces a neutral from AI. AI creates both challenges and opportunities that roughly balance.
